# preview-card API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Native Fluent cards with generated images or caller-owned previews.

## PreviewCard

Display a generated cover or custom preview with explicit actions and native Card behavior.
Defined preview overrides image; object slots request the region without probing callbacks.
Image errors preserve informative/decorative semantics and reset only for a changed src.
Uses the host Fluent theme/renderer without an SPFx provider. The forwarded ref targets
the native Card div; optional region/interaction behavior matches ContentCard.

### Imports

```ts
import { PreviewCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { PreviewCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { PreviewCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/preview-card';
```

### Use when

- A card needs generated cover media or custom preview content with explicit actions.

### Examples

#### Basic preview card

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { PreviewCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/preview-card';

<PreviewCard title="Report" image={{ src: '/report.jpg', alt: 'Report cover' }} actions={<button>Open report</button>} />
```

#### Report card with loading and notes

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { PreviewCard, AutoSkeleton } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

export function ReportCard({ thumbnail, brandLogo, isLoading, shareReport }: {
  thumbnail: string; brandLogo: string; isLoading: boolean; shareReport: () => void;
}): React.ReactElement {
  return <AutoSkeleton loading={isLoading}>
    <PreviewCard
      title="Monthly report" headingLevel={2} orientation="horizontal"
      description="October results."
      image={{ src: thumbnail, alt: 'Report cover with a revenue chart' }}
      logo={{ as: 'img', src: brandLogo, alt: 'Brand' }}
      headerActions={<Button appearance="subtle" onClick={shareReport}>Share</Button>}
      footer="Updated today"
      actions={<Button as="a" href="/report" appearance="primary">Open report</Button>}
    >
      <input aria-label="Notes" defaultValue="My notes" />
    </PreviewCard>
  </AutoSkeleton>;
}
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: PreviewCardProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | null
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: ContentCard attributes/slots, orientation and optional preview/image/logo content.

## PreviewCardProps

Native Card with a generated image or caller-owned preview and bounded logo overlay.
Inherits ContentCard's literal text, semantic heading, content slots and native interaction.
Any defined preview overrides image, including legacy null and conditional booleans.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import type { PreviewCardProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { PreviewCardProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { PreviewCardProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/preview-card';
```

### Media behavior

Generated images use cover fit. Failed media keeps the reserved area and logo placement; meaningful alt text retains role=img and its accessible name even with an empty custom fallback. Decorative media is hidden from assistive technology. Custom fallback controls remain inside that accessibility shell; use actions for independently accessible recovery controls. Only changing src retries a failed image.

### Layout and slots

Vertical and wrapped media uses 16:9 geometry. Horizontal media prefers an 8rem column with 12rem detail minimum and wraps according to container width; detail controls retain ancestry across orientation changes. Custom preview content owns its presentation. The logo inner ref identifies the bounded div/img, while native CardPreview owns the 32px overlay. Props/callback slots request containers without probing callbacks; raw HTML is unsupported. Inherited title, description, icon, headerActions, footer and actions retain ContentCard’s fixed tags, literal formatting and native interaction contracts. Native Card size defaults to medium, appearance to filled and the owned heading to h3. Requires the shared host Fluent theme/Griffel renderer, with no SPFx provider or implicit loading/navigation behavior.

### Examples (6)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { PreviewCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/preview-card';

<PreviewCard title="Report" image={{ src: '/report.jpg', alt: 'Report cover' }} actions={<button>Open</button>} />
```

### Type (4)

```ts
interface PreviewCardProps extends ContentCardProps
```
